items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: But he's a swell guy. He got me up, he pulled me up on a stand on the block in front of a lot of people and he gave me my life's history and all that... I said, folks I'm so glad you remember me

ctx.x: He wrote the Triangle Jazz Blues. Did you used to ever play that? No.
I wasn't there enough to him to hear it, because I was not. They asked me, but now you've heard of the Brunese brothers, Merrick Brunus, Abby Brunus, you know one of them died.
